description:
Reid Blacktop 1 SO | Electric urban bike
Designed for everyday commuting and city exploration – the Reid Blacktop 1 SO combines smooth electric assistance, practical components and a comfortable riding position in a sleek black finish.
The Reid Blacktop 1 SO is built for riders looking for a comfortable and reliable way to navigate city streets, commute to work and enjoy longer leisure rides. Its alloy frame features internal cable routing and an integrated 374Wh battery, creating a clean, streamlined design with balanced handling.
A responsive 250W rear hub motor provides electric assistance to help you tackle inclines and cover longer distances with greater ease. The Ananda D19 handlebar-mounted display features Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility, keeping essential ride information within easy reach. Shimano 8-speed gearing, trigger shifter and rear derailleur, offers reliable shifting across a versatile range of gears for changing urban terrain.
Tektro hydraulic disc brakes, with a 180mm front rotor and 160mm rear rotor, deliver reliable stopping power and control in varying conditions. The 27.5-inch wheels, fitted with 27.5 x 2.1-inch tyres, provide a balance of stability, traction and comfort across city streets and other urban surfaces.
A 700mm-wide oversized alloy handlebar with a comfortable rise and sweep supports an upright riding position, while the adjustable riser stem lets you fine-tune your setup. A city sport saddle provides comfort and support, while lock-on ergonomic grips help maintain a secure, comfortable hold on the handlebars. Alloy platform pedals complete the practical setup for everyday riding.
Finished in black, the Blacktop 1 SO combines understated styling with versatile electric assistance and commuter-ready features, making it a practical choice for everyday travel and urban leisure rides.
The Blacktop 1 SO is ideal for:

Everyday commuters looking for a practical electric-assisted way to travel to work

City and urban riding, with 27.5-inch wheels and 2.1-inch tyres for stability and traction

Riders tackling hills and longer journeys, with a 250W rear hub motor and integrated 374Wh battery

Riders who value reliable gearing, with Shimano Altus 8-speed components for adapting to varied terrain

Confident urban cycling, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm front and 160mm rear rotors

Comfort-focused cyclists, with an adjustable riser stem, ergonomic lock-on grips and a city sport saddle

Commuting and leisure rides, with a versatile setup suited to everyday journeys and exploring beyond the city

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
